latestVersion.changelog: 0.2.0 — default to NANDA Chapter Protocol v0.3 signing. Canonical string now binds method, url_path, body, agent_id, timestamp, and a 32-byte per-request nonce. Chapter side (all 5 production chapters) enforces (agent_id, nonce) uniqueness within ≥600 s. v0.2 (ed25519) remains available via --scheme ed25519 for older chapters. Closes the cross-endpoint replay + same-window replay weaknesses flagged in the ClawHub security audit.
